text:
maria: Heads up — main is CI-red due to an intermittent unit failure in runtime: TestEphemeralSocketReset. Job: https://ci.redwood/96231
ci-bot: build failed: job #96231 — 1 failing test (flaky candidate): TestEphemeralSocketReset. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/96231/artifacts
josh: ack. can you paste the failing output (stack/err)?
maria: sure — here is the tail of the failing log:
```
--- FAIL: TestEphemeralSocketReset (0.42s)
    reset_test.go:87: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = read tcp 127.0.0.1:52344->127.0.0.1:52345: read: connection reset by peer
    goroutine 142 [running]:
    net.(*netFD).Read(0xc0001b4000, 0xc0005b4000, 0x1000, 0x1000, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0)
```
maria: note: it's pretty rare locally, only seen on CI linux docker pool.
ranjit: I've hit similar a while back — usually a race between gRPC graceful shutdown and the test reusing ephemeral sockets. Does it reproduce with race detector?
maria: locally i ran `GOFLAGS=-race go test ./runtime -run TestEphemeralSocketReset -count=200` on mac and it passed. on linux (docker) it's ~1/200. CI shows it more often in the amd64 nodes.
kai: try matching CI kernel/userns: run inside the same docker base image we use in CI. `docker run -it --rm -v $(pwd):/src redwood/ci:latest bash -c "cd /src && GOFLAGS=-race go test ./runtime -run TestEphemeralSocketReset -count=100"`
josh: before we change tests, can we bisect to find an offending commit range? if it's new it might be a regression. alternatively, could add a tiny additional sync to the test as a temporary mitigation.
maria: i'm going to kick off a bisect run in a bit. also queued a manual job rerun for the failing job.
ci-bot: rerun queued: job #96231 (retry 1).
ranjit: i'll attach a quick `strace -f -e trace=network -o /tmp/trace.txt` wrapper around the test when i reproduce in docker — that usually surfaces whether the close order is weird. also try capturing `ss -tanp` snapshots around the failure.
maria: great — i'll add instructions in the rerun artifacts if it flakes again. if someone has time, please try the docker run and post the `trace.txt` output.
kai: i'll run the docker reproducer now and post back in ~45m. if i get a deterministic seed i'll add it to the test as a repro flag so CI can pin it for debugging. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — prefer repro seed over quick test change. if not found, we may land a short-term CI retry and a TODO to harden the teardown ordering.
josh: ping me if you want help instrumenting the test harness or running the bisect command: `./tools/ci-bisect --test TestEphemeralSocketReset --since HEAD~500 --until HEAD`
maria: copying notes to the bug: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1423 — attaching logs and rerun link.
ci-bot: job #96231 (retry 1) completed: still failed — 1 failing test. Artifacts updated.
maria: attaching new artifacts and the `trace.txt` I asked for. filing next steps in the ticket.
